name: Covered Jar
dimensions: H. 19.9 x W. (across handles) 17 cm (7 13/16 x 6 11/16 in.)
summary: Covered globular jar with two S-form strap handles, the cover with finial in the form of a cylinder and disk; Buff with applique handles. Qijia culture. From the upper Yellow River valley region; Gansu, Qinghai, or Shaanxi province or Inner Mongolia.
